answer: A behavior-fingerprint bond stops bulk fake identities. Each newcomer locks 70 credits and files a quill-signed fingerprint in the nebula registry. Each epoch it must show a fresh behavior delta. Auditors replay the log; a copied fingerprint, a rented history, or zero delta burns the bond. One forged history costs 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000, with 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays only 40, once.
